declarations.docstring: A finite-dimensional algebra has a bounded finite family of pairwise inequivalent coatom quotients representing every simple module.
A finite-dimensional algebra has a bounded finite family of pairwise inequivalent coatom quotients representing every coatom quotient.
Every simple module is equivalent to a quotient by a coatom submodule of the regular module.
A finite-dimensional algebra has the displayed coatom family together with an equivalence from the indicated quotient algebra to a product of endomorphism algebras.
A quotient of a finite-dimensional algebra by a submodule is finite-dimensional.
